attributes.title: 39th Annual LPCA Convention & Regional Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Licensed Professional Counselors Association of Georgia
attributes.organizer: Licensed Professional Counselors Association of Georgia
attributes.summary:
This year's theme is AI and counseling, a practical draw for anyone writing a practice policy on documentation tools or client chatbots. The convention names LPCs, APCs, social workers and LMFTs in its audience, and there is a dedicated track for CPCS renewal, which Georgia supervisors should look at first.

Registration is listed as coming soon and fees and hours are not published. The convention page lists May 25 as the pre-convention day and May 26 to 28 as the general convention, under the headline dates of May 25 to 28.
